title: Parity tuple Fourier weight
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let a tuple consist of $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set, each of size $k$, with empty symmetric difference. Its Fourier weight for $f$ is the product, over the parts, of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ indexed by the corresponding subsets.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
There are $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set
The symmetric difference of the subsets is empty
